name: faatix
description: Faatix business system — React frontend, Node.js API, MySQL database.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
